claims.claim: B had been to countries other than Australia
claims.mechanism: presupposition of 'too' in 'I thought you had been to Australia too' implies B had been to other places besides Australia

evidence.quote: I thought you had been to Australia too .

claims.verifier_basis: The word 'too' is a presupposition trigger that projects out of the belief context ('I thought'), entailing that B had been to other countries besides Australia.

claims.claim: B had been to at least one country
claims.mechanism: presupposition of 'which countries have you been to' that B has been to some countries

evidence.quote: which countries have you been to ?

claims.verifier_basis: The wh-question 'which countries' presupposes existence of at least one country B has been to.

claims.claim: B has not been to Australia
claims.mechanism: retracted belief: 'I thought you had been to Australia too' implies A is correcting a prior mistaken assumption, indicating B did not actually visit Australia

evidence.quote: I thought you had been to Australia too .

claims.verifier_basis: Past-tense 'thought' (rather than 'think') implicates the belief was wrong, i.e., B had NOT been to Australia.

claims.claim: B has been to some countries (at least one, excluding Australia)
claims.mechanism: presupposition in 'which countries have you been to' combined with 'too' in turn 3 indicating B has been to other countries

evidence.quote: which countries have you been to ?
I thought you had been to Australia too .

claims.verifier_basis: Combines the existence presupposition from 'which countries' (at least one) with the correction in turn 3 (not Australia), yielding B has been to at least one non-Australia country.
